fields.name: vptr

fields.name: work_tables_header
fields.how: first half of a 16-byte {header, tables} pair copied by the init slot (vtable +0x28, 0x71004e4210); slot 560 (0x71004e5360) returns this+0x10; probably the table count
fields.evidence: init copies the pair into +0x10/+0x18; reset slot 0x71004e4310 zeroes it

fields.name: work_tables
fields.how: array of WorkTable pointers indexed by (id >> 24) & 0xF: 0 = instance work (WORK_KIND_INSTANCE_WORK), 1 = status work (WORK_KIND_STATUS_WORK)
fields.evidence: every get/set/add/flag slot loads this+0x18 then indexes by (id>>24)&0xF; clear_all indexes it by its WorkKind argument

fields.name: table.float_count
fields.how: number of float variables; clear_all zeroes float_count*4 bytes
fields.evidence: clear_all 0x71004e5140 and init/reset memset(floats,0,count*4) from the pair at table+0x8/+0x10

fields.name: table.floats

fields.evidence: get/set/add/sub/mul/div/rnd_float

fields.name: float work variable
fields.how: plain load
fields.evidence: get_float slot 0x71004e4420 is a plain load along the fixed path; div_float skips a zero divisor; rnd_float stores a random value in [min,max] via set_float

fields.name: table.int_count
fields.how: number of int variables; clear_all zeroes int_count*8 bytes
fields.evidence: clear_all memset(ints,0,count*8)

fields.name: table.ints
fields.how: array of 8-byte slots: low 32 bits = int value, whole slot = int64 value (get_int and get_int64 share it); index = id & 0xFFFFFF
fields.evidence: set_int stores 32 bits at ints+8*i; set_int64/get_int64 use 64 bits at the same address

fields.name: int work variable
fields.how: get_int tail-calls the table object vtable +0x10 (not a plain load in the module); set/inc/dec/add/sub/mul/div/count_down act on the s32 at ints+8*i
fields.evidence: get_int slot 0x71004e4600; set_int 0x71004e4620; count_down_int decrements while value > floor and returns true when it reaches the floor; div_int skips zero divisor and zero value

fields.name: int64 work variable

fields.name: table.flag_word_count

fields.evidence: clear_all memset(flags,0,count*4)

fields.name: table.flag_words

fields.name: transition_term_count
fields.how: number of transition terms; loop bound of clear_transition_term / clear_transition_term_forbid (they call the per-term virtual unable / forbid-clear for each term); copied as a 16-byte pair with +0x28 by vtable slot 80 (0x71004e4410)

fields.name: transition_term_bytes
fields.how: one byte per term, index = term id & 0xFFFFFF: bit0 individual enable, bit1 group enabled, bit2 group_ex enabled, bit3 forbid, bit4 forbid_group, bit5 forbid_indivi
fields.evidence: enable/unable_transition_term set/clear 0x1 (unable clears 0x3); enable_transition_term_group_ex sets 0x4; *_forbid 0x8; slots 464/472 0x10; *_forbid_indivi 0x20

fields.name: transition term state
fields.how: computed: false if any forbid bit (0x38); else bit2 if bit1 set, else bit0
fields.evidence: is_enable_transition_term 0x71004e4c90; is_enable_transition_term_forbid returns (byte & 0x38) != 0

fields.name: transition_group_table
fields.how: block whose +0 is an array of 16-byte group entries {u32* term ids, s32 count at +8}, index = group id & 0xFFFFFF; group ops set/clear a bit in each listed term byte

notes: Both classes share every exported slot function; the base class (0x7104f74738, 72 bytes) ends at +0x44, the fighter class adds +0x44..+0x97. Work id encoding: bits 24-27 = table (0 instance, 1 status: ints 0x1000xxxx/0x1100xxxx, floats 0x0000xxxx/0x0100xxxx, flags 0x2000xxxx/0x2100xxxx; 0x20 and 0x21 masked by 0xF give 0 and 1), low 24 bits = index; flags use index>>5 for the word and index&31 for the bit. Table counts are not constants in the module: each table stores them (+0x8 floats, +0x18 ints, +0x28 flag words). From community constants the common fighter instance table holds at least 189 ints (FIGHTER_INSTANCE_WORK_ID_INT_TERM 0x100000bd), 76 floats (FLOAT_TERM 0x4c) and 224 flags (FLAG_TERM 0x200000e0 = 7 words); fighter-specific instance ids reach int 0x10a, float 0x6f, flag 0x115. Common status work reserves ints 0..4 (utility up to 8), floats 0..6, flags 0..11; fighter-specific status ids reach int 0x14, float 0x25, flag 0x29 (2 words). Weapons: instance int 10, float 3, flag 6 (WEAPON_INSTANCE_WORK_ID_*_TERM). Transition terms 0x1e000000..about 0x1e0000a8 (169 named), groups 0x1f000000..0x1f000011 (18). The table allocation site was not located (the init slot is only reached virtually), so exact runtime counts are unconfirmed. Slot 552 (0x71004e5190) clears the status table (index 1) keeping variables whose bit is set in three masks (int, float, flag), i.e. the FIGHTER_STATUS_WORK_KEEP_FLAG_* constants: masks cover the first 31 ints/floats and flag word 0, remaining flag words are zeroed; all-zero masks clear the whole status table. get_int is the only accessor that goes through the table object vtable (+0x10), probably for a range check.
